name: Pizzeria Ristorante Tyrolis
kurzbeschreibung: **Pizzeria Ristorante Tyrolis in Zirl** – Enjoy authentic Italian cuisine in the heart of Tirol! Indulge in freshly baked pizzas, handmade pasta, and classic dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn** with a twist. Cozy atmosphere, friendly service, and a perfect spot for a relaxed meal after exploring the stunning landscapes of Tirol. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this hidden gem offers a taste of Italy in the Alps.
